verdict.pick: Amazon Basics 13.2‑Gallon Rectangle Soft‑Close Trash Can
verdict.line: Buy this if you want a reliable kitchen bin that locks in odors and costs less than premium models; it’s easy to clean and fits most cabinets, but it lacks a foot pedal.
